title: Tile Prompt Flow: split a picture into tiles, upscale or detail each tile with its own prompt
description: A Flow, separate from the upscale op's prompt-less Use Tiles (MPI-1038): the picture is cut into tiles, each tile gets its own prompt (typed, or captioned), each is redrawn and stitched back. Doubles as a detailer at 1.0x. Source: Fabio's old per-tile-prompt workflow (he is finding it). Brief: brief.md.
